author: Liam Ottley
text:
Been trialling Alex Becker's dopamine detox approach lately.

All I do is:
- Work
- Read
- Stare at a wall

Bonus is that I have a new appreciation for good paintwork

topReplies.text: Being able to master this while holding a presence on social media is an art

topReplies.author: Dr. Libertad · verdad incómoda
topReplies.text: The trick isn't fasting, it's what you do with the wait. Dopamine isn't pleasure, it's wanting: the peak is in the pull of the screen, not in the like. Changing that, not the fasting, is what I research in my book I Love Dopamina.

topReplies.author: Ricky G
topReplies.text:
Staring at a wall is remarkably effective.

topReplies.author: rana
topReplies.text: Be bored deliberately and sit with discomfort it's quite literally a cheatcode

topReplies.author: Anton Zolotov
topReplies.text: That's what most people did before we created an entire industry around capturing digital attention.
